title: DriverPositionJumped v1 payload
description: Published by location when a driver's position, compared with the previous one of the same device session, implies a speed above the jump limit and both have good accuracy and no future time (REQ-DS-08, issue #71). Aggregate Driver. Ids and numbers only, never coordinates: operations decides whether it is an impossible movement and raises at most one risk flag per work session and hour. Nothing else happens to the driver or the trip.

track_point_id.description: The later of the two points.

recorded_at.description: Device time of the later point.
